title: Intention Service and executor boundary
summary: The ooRexx Intention Service builds proposals and READY-gated dispatch. A Python standard-library executor provides bounded commands and checks authorization again. It is not a general shell evaluator.
invariants: Keep semantic authority in Intention Service.
Do not invent a second SSH, XTP or Connect Selector implementation inside Computer.
A refused intention is not a license to bypass the interface using an arbitrary privileged shell.
